; Open reCalc directly above the notebook through AppLoad's window manager.
; The same original toolbar anchor is used by reInk; neither module requires
; the other one to load. No pen tool is selected by this application button.
AFFECT [[11313888899523275277]]
    IMPORT net.asivery.AppLoad 1.0
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        TRAVERSE [[6502786168]]#[[233745975898428]] > [[8398044571386570029]]
            LOCATE AFTER [[7712155293725601]]#[[15827066597889961342]]
            INSERT {
                ToolbarTool {
                    id: repaperCalculatorTool
                    objectName: "RePaperCalculatorTool"
                    toolbar: ~&6504254477&~
                    type: ToolbarTool.Type.ToolbarButton
                    visible: ~&6504254477&~.expanded
                    enabled: !~&6504254477&~.dragging && !(typeof ~&6504254477&~.repaperEditorHost !== "undefined" && ~&6504254477&~.repaperEditorHost && ~&6504254477&~.repaperEditorHost.nativeOperationPending)
                    iconSource: "qrc:/appload/icons/calculator"
                    label: "Calculatrice"
                    onClicked: {
                        ~&6504254477&~.closeFoldout()
                        AppLoadLauncher.launchApplication("external::recalc", [], {}, true)
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
